title: Seeking a Norwegian ship job and the translation
summary: He tried to get work on a Norwegian ship because he spoke the language and knew how to catch Germans by a word, and recalls translating for a Norwegian ship.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Now, I'm finished with that. I said, well, I'd like to get a job -- on a Norwegian ship because there was a lot of Germans come in there and and they didn't know they was Germans. There was some words in Norwegian that a German will be caught up on and the word is Jasca han las...oun..."(?) "Jasca han los glas vater"(?) A German will say /unaudible/, because it is so much like his word for water that he will get hung up on -- I would like a glass of water.
So, I went and asked for the job and he said, oh, yes, sir it would be nice if you do that.
You remember when that Norweigan ship come in here and couldn't nobody translate? I translated it and took my time translating, (Oh, yeah, yeah, that's right.
I said, well, what's that got to do -- somebody sweeping up around here. He said, you can do that and sweep up after.
I said well, then, when I understood. See, I had gotten away from that for such a long time that I was

somewhat surprised.
I forgot that, after all, you are back here now,
and that's it.
